entries.title: Two years of OpenAI Academy
entries.summary: Marking two years of OpenAI Academy and bringing AI skills to even more communities.

entries.title: OpenAI extends cyber access to Ukraine for civilian defense
entries.summary: OpenAI is extending access to its Daybreak program to the Government of Ukraine to support the cyber defense of civilian infrastructure.

entries.title: Grab and OpenAI bring practical AI skills to Southeast Asia
entries.summary: OpenAI and Grab launch GO Forward with AI, a regional programme helping 30,000 partners build practical AI skills across Southeast Asia.

entries.title: Better prompt caching for GPT-6
entries.summary: Learn how GPT-6 improves prompt caching with higher cache hit rates, new diagnostics, explicit breakpoints, and controls that reduce latency and costs.

entries.title: Introducing GPT-6 Sol and Luna
entries.summary: Meet GPT-6 Sol and Luna, two models that bring frontier intelligence to everyday work with different balances of capability and cost.

entries.title: Parallel cut research time and cost in half with GPT‑6 Astra
entries.summary: GPT‑6 Astra allowed Parallel’s agents to research and synthesize labor-market data in half the time and at half the cost vs. prior models.

entries.title: Priorities and principles for effective third party assessments
entries.summary: OpenAI outlines priorities and principles for rigorous, secure, and independent third-party AI safety assessments of frontier models and safeguards.

entries.title: Higgsfield AI ships new video features in a day with GPT-6 Astra
entries.summary: With GPT-6 Astra, Higgsfield AI makes video ad creation easier for small businesses and brings new creative tools to market faster.

entries.title: Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence
entries.summary: OpenAI is working with an independent Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence to guide the review and communication of emerging AI results.

entries.title: Building standards for the next phase of AI
entries.summary: OpenAI outlines a path to shared global AI standards, calling for coordinated evaluation, reporting, and governance to improve safety.
